# Components

What a note can carry. A note is a markdown file, and each block under `ghost:` in its frontmatter is a component attached to it. **New** in the notes list makes a note with nothing attached, **+** attaches a component and the × on its card takes it off again, and what a note does is read off what it has attached.

Components - the parts a note is made of (next/notes.md, "A component"). One registry shaped like `Medium`'s: each entry says what the component is, what it needs and what it gives, the components it brings with it, the room it takes in a note, what it asks of the platform (`Capabilities`), which groups of the script's marks it brings, the frontmatter block it keeps, and the card it is set on.

A NOTE IS WHAT ITS COMPONENTS MAKE IT. There is one kind of new note - its words and nothing else - and "+" attaches the rest (`attach_menu`); what a note can do, which panel runs it (`workspace_of`) and what it may take next are read off what is attached, never off a list of kinds of note. A song and a Picture is a seeded show; add a Storyboard and it is a show written by hand; a Voice reads the words, and Cards has agents write them.

NEEDS AND PROVIDES ARE TYPED NAMES that ghost matches, the way a scene's `morph_out` and `morph_in` already are: "text", "audio", "reading", "picture", "moments". A component never names another to work - only what it needs - so a need nobody provides is a sentence on a card, never a branch somewhere else.

SLOTS SAY HOW MANY (`SLOTS`): components that name the same slot are alternatives, and a note has one of them. A show has one clock and one presentation, so a song and a voice are not attached together - "+" grays the second, and says which to detach.

THE STAGE IS A CAPABILITY: anything shown on it asks for `forward_plus`, the desktop renderer, so on a phone - where a note is its text and nothing more - every component but the text is impossible and "+" offers nothing (`attach_menu`).

A CARD ANY PANEL CAN SHOW IS A ROW'S `script`: the path of the script that builds the component's card, loaded when a panel builds it (`NoteCards.make`). By path because this registry is under every card (docs/structure.md): a row is how it names one. The script answers `KEY` (its block), `for_note(ctx)`, `capture()` and `apply(block)`; `tests/notes/components_check.gd` loads each and holds it to that.

Static and free of autoload names, like `Capabilities`, so a gate can read it under `--script`.

Registry: `Components.REGISTRY` in [src/notes/components.gd](../src/notes/components.gd) (18 components, 2 slots, 6 workspaces).

## Slots

Where a note has room for exactly one. Components that take the same slot are alternatives: **+** grays the second, and says which to detach.

| Slot | What it is | Taken by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clock` | What the show is timed by, and how long it is: a song, a voice reading the text, or a clip. | Song, Voice, Voice lab, Clip |
| `presentation` | What the show is seen in: the Picture and the medium it names, a card table, a voice lab's own show, or a clip's own frame. | Voice lab, Picture, Table, Proof, Letter, Actor, Clip |

## Workspaces

The panels that run a note. Most components are a card on whichever panel is up; a few are an editor of their own and name the workspace that is. Where two attached components name one, a component another brings gives way to the one that brings it.

| Workspace | Named by | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Note** (`note`) | no component: the default | The note's own panel: its words, and a card for each thing attached. |
| **Reading** (`reading`) | Voice | A voice reads the note: the cast, each speaker's delivery and room, the stream. |
| **Table** (`table`) | Table | A show at a table: the episodes agents make from the note's brief - cards drawn, things made, or both - and the voice that reads them. |
| **Proof** (`proof`) | Proof | A ghost doing math at a desk: the episodes agents make from the note's problem, and the voice that teaches them. |
| **Voice lab** (`lab`) | Voice lab | Ghost Notes' own synthesizer and the fishing game that breeds its voices. |
| **Masking** (`clip`) | Clip | A clip's editor: its markers, tracks, effects and timeline. |

## Components

By family - the color a component's card, chip and marks are drawn in.

### Text

- **Text** (`text`) - The note's own words: what a voice reads, the brief an agent works from, or just a note.
  - gives text
- **Intro & outro** (`bookends`) - Seconds held before the first word and after the last.
  - needs audio; asks for `forward_plus`; kept in `bookends:`

### Producer

- **Table** (`table`) - Agents plan, paint and write a show at a table, a beat at a time: cards drawn and read, things made - or both. The note's words are the show's brief: they say what is done there.
  - needs text; gives text, picture, moments; brings Voice; takes the presentation; asks for `forward_plus`, `subprocess`, `agent:writer`, `agent:painter`; kept in `table:`
- **Proof** (`proof`) - Agents work a math problem at a desk - the note's words are the problem - check the proof in Lean, and teach it: a pen writes each formula on a pad while the voice explains.
  - needs text; gives text, picture, moments; brings Voice; takes the presentation; asks for `forward_plus`, `subprocess`, `agent:writer`, `tex`, `lean`, `python:math`; kept in `proof:`

### Voice

- **Voice** (`voice`) - A small local neural voice reads the text: a cast of speakers, their delivery and their room.
  - needs text; gives audio, reading, moments; takes the clock; asks for `stage`, `subprocess`, `python:voice`; kept in `voice:`
- **Voice training** (`voice_training`) - Teaches a voice to speak as someone does, from their own recordings - a folder, files, or links to videos, playlists or a channel: their speech heard, cut into clean sentences, and a voice fine-tuned on them on the graphics card. The note reads in it, and every Voice card can pick it.
  - needs reading; brings Voice; asks for `subprocess`, `ffmpeg`, `python:voice`, `python:speech`, `python:download`, `python:voice_train`; kept in `voice_training:`
- **Voice lab** (`voice_lab`) - Ghost Notes' own synthesizer reads the text, and the fishing game breeds its voices.
  - needs text; gives audio, reading, moments; brings Scenes; takes the clock and the presentation; asks for `stage`; kept in `synthesis:`

### Sound

- **Song** (`song`) - A song the show is cut on: its beat and its spectrum drive the scenes.
  - gives audio; takes the clock; asks for `stage`; kept in `song:`

### Picture

- **Scenes** (`scenes`) - The visualizer scenes, chosen by the seed and cut on the sound.
  - needs audio; gives picture, moments; asks for `forward_plus`
- **Storyboard** (`storyboard`) - The show written down: which scenes play, in what order, how long each stays and how it leaves - and, on a stage, who is there and what they do. Nothing written, and the seed chooses.
  - needs audio, places; gives picture; brings Scenes; asks for `forward_plus`; kept in `scenes:`
- **Picture** (`picture`) - A show for the note, and what it is carried on: Auto (the seeded show, nothing to set), full frame, a comic, a book, a notebook, a tablet.
  - needs picture; gives places; brings Scenes; takes the presentation; asks for `forward_plus`; kept in `picture:`
- **Illustrations** (`illustrations`) - The book's pictures, painted by an agent from the marks in the text, or imported.
  - needs text, places; gives picture; brings Picture; asks for `forward_plus`; kept in `illustrations:`
- **Letter** (`letter`) - The note read as a letter written by hand at a desk: the pen writes each paragraph as the voice reads it, crosses lines out, draws the sketches the letter describes, taps while the writer thinks, and a picture takes the screen for a passage read over it.
  - needs reading; gives picture; brings Voice; takes the presentation; asks for `forward_plus`, `subprocess`, `agent:writer`, `tex`, `python:math`; kept in `letter:`
- **Actor** (`actor`) - An actor reads the note in their own room, built from their own videos - a folder, or links to videos, playlists or a channel: the footage surveyed and grouped by camera and look, a still of them chosen, and their motion, blinks, mouths and voice learned from every video. Every pixel of them is their own.
  - needs reading; gives picture; brings Voice; takes the presentation; asks for `forward_plus`, `subprocess`, `ffmpeg`, `python:face`, `python:speech`, `python:download`, `agent:writer`; kept in `actor:`
- **Clip** (`clip`) - A video, cut and prepared from a file or a link, with chroma-key effects over it: markers, tracks and renders.
  - gives picture, audio; takes the clock and the presentation; asks for `forward_plus`, `subprocess`, `ffmpeg`; kept in `clip:`

### Look

- **Look** (`look`) - A post-process over the whole picture: grain, noir, a vignette, and the rest.
  - needs picture; asks for `forward_plus`; kept in `look:`
- **Masks** (`masks`) - Chroma-key effects over a clip: markers, tracks and renders.
  - needs picture; brings Clip; asks for `forward_plus`, `subprocess`, `ffmpeg`

### Publish

- **YouTube** (`youtube`) - Uploads the exported video to your YouTube channel: its title, who may see it and the playlist it joins.
  - needs picture, audio; asks for `movie_export`, `subprocess`, `ffmpeg`; kept in `youtube:`

## Capabilities

What a component may ask of the platform. Each is possible somewhere or not at all, and **+** leaves out what is impossible here and grays what is not ready yet, with the reason; the same table is checked wherever a program is started. On a phone, a note is its text and nothing else.

| Capability | What it is | Possible on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `subprocess` | starting programs | the desktop |
| `ffmpeg` | FFmpeg | the desktop |
| `python:voice` | the voice environment | the desktop |
| `python:download` | the download environment | the desktop |
| `python:capture` | the page-capture environment | the desktop |
| `python:face` | the body and face-tracking environment | the desktop |
| `python:speech` | the speech-recognition environment | the desktop |
| `python:voice_train` | the voice-training environment | the desktop |
| `tex` | TeX | the desktop |
| `python:math` | the math environment | the desktop |
| `lean` | Lean and Mathlib | the desktop |
| `agent:writer` | an AI writer | the desktop |
| `agent:painter` | an AI painter | the desktop |
| `movie_export` | rendering a video | the desktop |
| `checkout` | running from the repository | a checkout of the repository |
| `forward_plus` | the desktop renderer | the desktop |
| `stage` | the show (a stage that plays) | the desktop |
| `mic` | a microphone | the desktop |

Source: `Capabilities.TABLE` in [src/platform/capabilities.gd](../src/platform/capabilities.gd)
